execution.description: The broad regression run after the remote-setup wiring, through scripts/dev/canonical.sh.

expected: No regression outside the remote route: the attach door builds a remote runner only for a campaign that declares remote practice.
observed: One regression. The standard CLI attach door resolved the campaign's Challenge to build its remote runner before the registration read, even for a runtime with no remote practice. A test that holds 'registration before any campaign write' uses a manifest naming no Challenge, so the attach failed earlier than that test's specimen expects. Resolving the Challenge only when the runtime declares remote_gpu, as the battery door already did, fixed it. Focused runs had not covered the service suite.
keep: Run the service suites that drive both campaign doors whenever a door gains a step, not only the CPU tests next to the change.
A new door step that applies to one runtime kind is guarded by that runtime key, so every other campaign's ordering is unchanged.
change: Start a long regression run in the background with a long enough timeout, and check its summary before the hub commit, so a fix lands before the hub repin.
protocol_elements: door changes are checked against both doors' ordering tests
